title: Cyber Operation: Russian-speaking malware tooling
summary: OpenAI banned accounts likely linked to Russian-speaking criminal groups, using AI to build malware loaders, evasion layers, credential-theft scripts, and C2 infrastructure.
body: OpenAI banned accounts likely linked to Russian-speaking criminal groups, using AI to build malware loaders, evasion layers, credential-theft scripts, and C2 infrastructure.
summaryZh: OpenAI封禁了疑似与俄语网络犯罪团伙相关的账户，其利用AI技术构建恶意软件加载器、逃逸层、凭据窃取脚本以及命令控制基础设施。原始信息显示：OpenAI banned accounts likely linked to Russian-speaking criminal groups, using AI to build malware loaders, evasion layers, credential-theft scripts, and C2 infrastructure.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Cyber Operation: Russian-speaking malware tooling”。其重要性主要体现在：阐述了俄罗斯背景犯罪集团如何利用AI构建逃逸层和C2基础设施，凸显了大模型双面性。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
